facts.fact: The Egyptian Supreme Cybersecurity Council's National Cybersecurity Strategy 2017-2021 (updated November 2018) sets five programmes for the period, including CERTs or CSIRTs in the critical sectors; it gives no adoption date, so as_of is the start of the stated period.

The strategy states the Egyptian Supreme Cybersecurity Council, reporting to the Cabinet and chaired by the ICT minister, began preliminary work in January 2015 and the Prime Minister approved the formation of its Executive Bureau and Technical Committee in June 2016.
